parameters.content:
## Draft: n8n initiates the local Harness job
Daily at 8 AM Pacific. Reads only published stable GitHub releases; unchanged content stops here.

The two Harness write nodes are deliberately DISABLED. Before activation: approve the exact workflow and dedicated connection; confirm n8n can reach the Mac; select a job-only Harness project and HTTP Bearer credential; promote and verify the initial release page; change the website snapshot URL from playground to main; enable both write nodes and test accepted vs completed behavior.

Model: TritonAI On-Prem / GLM 5.3. No cloud fallback. Only release metadata, summaries, and direct installer metadata may be pushed after all site gates.

A successful trigger does not prove publication. Verify the worker result and production page.
